title: SEC4: XCID body-reading loop missing NNTP format comment
description: In xcid_client.rs run_xcid_protocol (~lines 174-189), the loop that reads base64 body lines until a standalone '.' has no comment explaining the NNTP dot-terminated multi-line body format. A reader unfamiliar with NNTP wire format will not understand why a lone '.' terminates the body, why lines are stripped of whitespace before accumulation, or why an empty line (not just '.') signals EOF. A brief comment referencing RFC 3977 §3.1.1 (dot-stuffing and dot-termination) would make this self-contained.
